text: The University of Texas at Dallas is a top-ranked public research university located in Richardson, Texas. Founded in 1969, UT Dallas has evolved into a leading STEM-focused institution with more than 29,000 students and 500+ degree programs.

metadata.source_title: About UT Dallas | The University of Texas at Dallas

text: UT Dallas offers a wide range of undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral programs across eight schools: Arts, Technology, and Emerging Communication; Arts and Humanities; Behavioral and Brain Sciences; Engineering and Computer Science; Interdisciplinary Studies; Management; Natural Sciences and Mathematics; and Economic, Political and Policy Sciences.
